meta.purpose: Drop-in marketing copy for the /admin/marketing dashboard and reactivation campaign launcher (FRONT TWO).
voice_rules: Short sentences. Local first. Specific beats generic.
One CTA per asset. Every outbound message carries an unsubscribe path.
Only claims we can back: seasonal pest behavior, service names, phone numbers, referral offer.
SMS bodies stay within 160 chars literal (validated 2026-08-08).
meta.render_note: Engine currently supports name/city/pest/season/unsubscribe_url only. Recommended: add {{phone}} so AZ customers get (602) 755-8414 and WA customers get (509) 471-5767 instead of a hardcoded number.
